endorsements.quote: Approaches include continuous monitoring of all model inputs and outputs, at least bi-annual assessment of model performance, and development of new algorithms for adjacent use cases and when model performance deteriorates.

unlisted_practices: Operational or academic leadership should invest in a designated innovation institute or center with dedicated funds and staff to coordinate innovation efforts across the organization.
Health systems should require a frontline clinician on each innovation project team.
Health systems should hire and train staff with expertise in design thinking, lean methodology, product development, and data analytics to support frontline clinicians in implementing pilots.
Health systems should require sign-off from an operational leader who controls resources before starting an innovation project.

screen.reason: Descriptive case study / commentary describing the governance, principles, and practices of the Duke Institute for Health Innovation (DIHI) for developing and scaling healthcare innovations including AI/machine learning.
